ideas.title: Uncovering Child Care Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of child care fraud in Minnesota and identify potential perpetrators.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and track the flow of funds in state programs
questions: What is the extent of child care fraud in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a large-scale fraud scheme and bring perpetrators to justice. By following the money and tracking the flow of funds, we can identify key players and uncover the truth.

ideas.title: Corporate Discrimination: A Growing Concern
ideas.description: Investigate the trend of corporate discrimination and its impact on employees and companies.
ideas.angle: Analyze diversity and inclusion initiatives and their effectiveness
questions: What is the prevalence of corporate discrimination?
How effective are diversity and inclusion initiatives?
ideas.insight: This story can shed light on the importance of diversity and inclusion initiatives in preventing corporate discrimination. By analyzing data and trends, we can identify best practices and provide recommendations for companies.
